description: This file defines a class AzureOpenAIFineTuningAPI that extends functionalities for Azure-specific OpenAI fine-tuning operations, inheriting from both a base Azure utility class and the OpenAI fine-tuning handler. It includes an overridden method to initialize the Azure OpenAI client with custom parameters.
